name: Sunrise
source:
Lady Sofia has just broken things off with her former love in favor of his kinder brother, but when things take a turn for the worse, will her new relationship survive? ...And more importantly, perhaps, will she?

Once upon a time, in a world that is much like our own, there lies a relic of ancient Europe in the middle of a desert in the Wild Wild West.

There, kings and queens still rule the land, and in one such kingdom the sovereign lord has recently died.

Two brothers, princes, remain. One is drawn by the old ways and the other is swept up in the winds of change.

Abel, the eldest, is set to inherit the throne.

The younger, Shiye, plans to marry their childhood friend... Sofia.

All fairy tales are supposed to have a happy ending...

This is not that kind of story.

[From [url=http://luckysunscribes.itch.io/sunrise]itch.io[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2015.
translation:
索菲婭小姐剛和前任戀人分手，選擇了他更溫柔的弟弟；可當事態急轉直下，她的新戀情能否存續？更重要的是，她能否安然度過？

很久以前，在一個與我們相似的世界裡，狂野西部的沙漠中央坐落著一處古老歐洲遺蹟。那裡依然由國王與王后統治，而其中一個王國的君主最近去世了。

留下兩兄弟，兩位王子。一人眷戀舊日傳統，另一人則被變革之風席捲。

長子亞伯將繼承王位。

弟弟希耶計畫迎娶他們的青梅竹馬……索菲婭。

所有童話都應該有幸福結局……

但這不是那種故事。
